lines.en: label day5:
scene newdreaming1
: So, are you back to normal yet or is your brain still being stupid?
lines.zh: : 那么，你恢复正常了吗，还是说你的脑子还在犯傻？

lines.en: : I don’t think “being stupid” is the right way to describe what is currently happening to my brain-
lines.zh: : 我觉得用「犯傻」来形容我脑子现在的状态不太合适——

lines.en: : But if you’re asking if I have somehow miraculously remembered everything that has ever happened to me within the last 48 hours, the answer is no.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是问我有没有奇迹般地想起过去 48 小时里发生过的所有事，答案是，没有。

lines.en: : Well, did you have a good weekend at least? I’m sure that must have helped {i}a little bit,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 那至少周末过得还不错吧？我觉得那总该起了{i}一点{/i}作用，对吧？

lines.en: : It...certainly helped me realize that I don’t really have anything to complain about and that my life seems pretty good here.
lines.zh: : 那确实……让我意识到我其实没什么可抱怨的，而且我在这儿的生活看起来还挺好的。

lines.en: scene newdreaming2
: Well, it didn’t get that way overnight, you know? We worked super hard to get to where we are now and I’m not about to let early onset dementia take that away from us.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，这一切可不是一夜之间就有的啊？我们可是拼了命才走到今天这一步，我可不会让什么早发性痴呆把它从我们手里抢走。

lines.en: : I don’t have dementia, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我没有痴呆，Ami。

lines.en: : Silly, Sensei. Nobody ever {i}knows{/i} they have dementia. You clearly do and should just listen to me since I know more about you than even you do.
lines.zh: : 傻啦，Sensei。得了痴呆的人自己是不会{i}知道{/i}的。你显然就是，所以乖乖听我的吧，毕竟我比你本人还了解你。

lines.en: : You know, when I woke up this morning, it didn’t really occur to me that being gaslit by my niece on the way to school was a possibility.
lines.zh: : 说真的，今早醒来的时候，我可真没想到「在上学路上被自己侄女精神操控」也会成为现实里的一种可能。

lines.en: scene newdreaming3
: Anything is possible in Kumon-mi, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 在 Kumon-mi 什么都有可能，Sensei！

lines.en: : Again, not really the response I expected or wanted to hear.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这可真不是我预料中、也不是我想听到的回答。

lines.en: I’m on my way to school with Ami to start my first {i}full{/i} week as a teacher.
lines.zh: 我正和 Ami 一起走在上学的路上，准备开始我当老师的第一{i}整{/i}周。

lines.en: Friday went by pretty well for the most part but, of course, that was just one day. And for all I know, this whole {i}teaching{/i} thing could actually be pretty hard.
lines.zh: 周五总的来说过得还算顺利，但说到底那也只是一天而已。而且说不定，{i}教书{/i}这整件事其实会相当难。

lines.en: Despite sharing her...hesitations in terms of my “new” teaching methods, I doubt Makoto is the type to report me to any of the higher-ranking school officials-
lines.zh: 尽管 Makoto 对我那套「全新」的教学方式抱有……疑虑，但我并不觉得她是那种会把我举报给上级校方的类型——

lines.en: So the biggest issue right now is really just getting to know everyone and making sure I’m able to get through each day without dramatically ruining everything.
lines.zh: 所以眼下最大的问题，其实就只是把每个人都认熟，并确保自己能一天天熬过去，不至于戏剧性地把一切全搞砸。

lines.en: {i}How{/i} I’d go about ruining everything when I’m so focused on not drawing any attention to myself, I have no idea.
lines.zh: 可我都这么专注于不引人注目了，究竟还能{i}怎么{/i}把一切搞砸，我自己也没头绪。

lines.en: But these are teenage girls we’re talking about- violently seizing all over the floor during the most impressionable times of their lives.
lines.zh: 但我们说的可是十几岁的女高中生——在她们一生中最易受影响的年岁里，在地板上剧烈地抽搐个不停。

lines.en: I can’t remember if there’s any truth to it, but I believe that the best thing to do during times like this is to just let the seizure play out and not do anything to stop it.
lines.zh: 我不记得这种说法到底有没有道理，但我相信在这种时候最好的做法，就是让抽搐自己发作完，别做任何去阻止它的事。

lines.en: That’s not medical advice or anything- just the words and insight of a man who, at this point in time, has but one goal in life-
lines.zh: 这当然不是什么医疗建议——只是一个男人此刻的言论与见识，而他此生只剩下一个目标——

lines.en: To have sex with as many of his students as possible.
lines.zh: 和他的学生上床，越多越好。

lines.en: And to not get caught in the process of that.
lines.zh: 以及，在这个过程中不要被抓住。

lines.en: scene newdreaming4
But, of course...every plan has obstacles.
lines.zh: 但当然……任何计划都会有障碍。

lines.en: And it appears that one of those obstacles is now walking to school with me as well.
lines.zh: 而现在看来，其中一个障碍也正和我一起走在上学的路上。

lines.en: : Morning, Maya! I figured you’d be halfway to school already. I didn’t expect you to come meet up with us along the way.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Maya！我还以为你都已经走到半路了呢。没想到你会特意绕过来跟我们汇合。

lines.en: : Am I interrupting “family time?”
lines.zh: : 我是不是打搅了你们的「家庭时光」？

lines.en: : You’re not interrupting anything. Me and Sensei were just-
lines.zh: : 你什么都没打搅啦。我和 Sensei 只是在——

lines.en: : Sensei and I.
lines.zh: : 是 Sensei 和我。

lines.en: scene newdreaming5
: What? School doesn’t start for another half hour. Can’t you wait until I switch shoes to start teaching me grammar?
lines.zh: : 什么啊？离上课还有半个钟头呢。你就不能等我换完室内鞋再开始教我语法吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m just trying to look cool in front of Maya so she stops thinking I am the devil incarnate.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是想在 Maya 面前显得酷一点，好让她别再觉得我是恶魔化身。

lines.en: : If the devil existed, I {i}do{/i} imagine he’d look something like you.
lines.zh: : 如果恶魔真的存在，我{i}倒{/i}觉得他大概就长你这样。

lines.en: : But I also want to make it clear that correcting Ami’s grammar is very low on the list of “things that I think will make you cool.”
lines.zh: : 但我也想说清楚，在「我觉得能让你变酷的事」这份清单里，纠正 Ami 的语法排得非常靠后。

lines.en: : Can I know what’s at the top of the list, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 那我能不能知道，排在最前面的是什么？

lines.en: scene newdreaming6
: Not talking to me.
lines.zh: : 别跟我说话。

lines.en: : I’m upset with myself for walking into that.
lines.zh: : 我对自己会主动踩进这个坑感到挺失望的。

lines.en: : I’m starting to doubt whether you lost your memories at all after hearing the two of you go at it like that first thing in the morning...
lines.zh: : 一大早就听你俩这么你来我往的，我都开始怀疑你到底有没有失忆了……

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Ami. You’re not the only one here inherently doubting who I am as a person.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Ami。这里会打心底怀疑我这个人是什么货色的，可不止你一个。

lines.en: scene newdreaming7
You {i}are{/i}, however, the only person here who believes that I am who I say I am.
lines.zh: 不过，你也是这里唯一一个相信我{i}就是{/i}我自称的那个人的。

lines.en: : Umm...anyway! {i}Sensei and I{/i} were just talking about how he spent his weekend and whether or not this little brain slump of his will stop him from doing his best in school.
lines.zh: : 呃……总之！{i}我和 Sensei{/i} 刚刚在聊他周末是怎么过的，还有他这次小小的脑子宕机会不会影响他在学校里拿出最好的表现。

lines.en: : Interesting. I didn’t realize he had a “best.”
lines.zh: : 有意思。我还不知道他有「最好的表现」这种东西。

lines.en: scene newdreaming8
: Hey, why did you come all the way over here to meet up with us if you’re just going to spend the whole walk being mean to Sensei?
lines.zh: : 诶，你既然一整段路都打算拿来损 Sensei，那干嘛还特地绕过来跟我们汇合啊？

lines.en: : Apologies. I do agree that I might be a little harsher than normal this morning.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我也承认，今天早上我说话确实比平时刻薄了些。

lines.en: : I just haven’t been sleeping well lately and this is something that I am apparently just going to do in order to compensate for that.
lines.zh: : 只是我最近一直睡不好，而这件事显然就成了我用来补偿的方式。

lines.en: : Does...insulting my uncle give you energy or something?
lines.zh: : 那个……骂我叔叔能给你补充能量还是怎么的？

lines.en: : No. But it does help me sleep a little better at night knowing that {i}someone{/i} is actively calling him out for being the type of person he is.
lines.zh: : 不能。但知道{i}有人{/i}正主动站出来指责他是那种人，确实能让我晚上睡得稍微好一点。

lines.en: : I liked this walk better when it was just Ami and me.
lines.zh: : 我还是更喜欢只有我和 Ami 一起走的那段路。

lines.en: scene newdreaming9
: Ami and {i}I!{/i} Ha!
lines.zh: : 是 Ami 和{i}我{/i}！哈！

lines.en: : Wrong.
scene newdreaming10
: What?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么啊？！

lines.en: : Ask me again in half an hour when I am getting paid for this.
lines.zh: : 等半小时后我开始拿工资了再问我吧。

lines.en: : Is my love not payment enough?!
lines.zh: : 我的爱难道还不算报酬吗？！

lines.en: : Will your love put food on the table?
lines.zh: : 你的爱能换来餐桌上的食物吗？

lines.en: : It does every single morning! I’m basically your personal maid, you know!
lines.zh: : 每天早上都能啊！我基本上就是你的专属女仆，好吗！

lines.en: : Huh. I guess we’ll have to get you a uniform then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那看来得给你弄套制服了。

lines.en: scene newdreaming11
: Uhh...ew?
: I mean...I don’t really have any money. But if you wanted to buy me one, I don’t think I’d have a problem wearing it around the house.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我其实没什么钱。不过要是你想给我买一套，在家里穿穿我也是不介意的。

lines.en: scene newdreaming12
: Uhh...{i}ew?{/i}
: What? It’s not fair if you’re the only one who gets to wear a cute costume all the time.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？总不能只有你一个人天天穿可爱的制服吧，这不公平。

lines.en: : The miko dress is not a {i}costume.{/i} It’s something I literally have to wear when tending to the shrine.
lines.zh: : 巫女服不是{i}制服{/i}。那是我在神社当值时真的必须穿的东西。

lines.en: : Why, though? Will the gods smite you if they see you wearing your normal clothes or something?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？难不成神明看到你穿平常的衣服就会降下天罚之类的？

lines.en: scene newdreaming13
: Who knows? Gods {i}do{/i} have a history of creating asinine rules and then dishing out punishment to those who refuse to abide by them.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？神明{i}确实{/i}一向有制定蠢透了的规矩、再惩罚那些不肯遵守之人的前科。

lines.en: : Frankly, being {i}smitten{/i} by them would solve a multitude of problems for me when my existence is nothing short of {i}Hell{/i} to begin with.
lines.zh: : 老实说，反正我的存在本身就是一场{i}地狱{/i}，能被他们降下{i}天罚{/i}，反倒能替我解决一大堆问题。

lines.en: : Wow. You really {i}haven’t{/i} been sleeping well, have you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你是真的{i}没{/i}睡好啊，对吧？

lines.en: scene newdreaming14
: No...I really haven’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是真的没睡好。

lines.en: : I keep having these...strange dreams lately. And it’s as if they’re getting even stranger as the days go by.
lines.zh: : 最近我老是做一些……很奇怪的梦。而且随着日子一天天过去，那些梦好像还越来越奇怪了。

lines.en: : Dreams? What kind of dreams?
lines.zh: : 梦？什么样的梦？

lines.en: : They’re hard to describe. It’s like reality, but...
lines.zh: : 很难形容。就像现实一样，但是……

lines.en: : Upside down?
lines.zh: : 上下颠倒？

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t get that at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我完全听不懂。

lines.en: scene newdreaming15
: I didn’t expect you to.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望你听得懂。

lines.en: : This sort of thing always happens around the start of a cycle. I wouldn’t worry too much about it.
lines.zh: : 这种事在一个周期开始的时候总会发生。我不会太放在心上。

lines.en: : Cycle? Do you mean...semester?
lines.zh: : 周期？你是说……学期？

lines.en: scene newdreaming16
: Yes, that.
lines.zh: : 对，就是那个。

lines.en: : I really should be sleeping more, shouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我真的该多睡一点了，是吧？

lines.en: : I guess so. But you already sleep, like...way more than everybody else I know. So maybe this is some kind of medical thing?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。可你已经睡得……比我认识的任何人多太多了。所以会不会是某种身体上的毛病啊？

lines.en: : Or, even worse- what if you and Sensei {i}both{/i} have dementia?
lines.zh: : 或者更糟——万一你和 Sensei {i}都{/i}得了痴呆怎么办？

lines.en: : Yeah, I...don’t really think that’s what’s going on here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……真不觉得是这么回事。

lines.en: : Maybe Maya would sleep a little better if you stayed at the dorms a little more often?
lines.zh: : 也许你多留在宿舍住一阵，Maya 就能睡得好一点？

lines.en: scene newdreaming17
: What? But why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 什么？可我为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Because...you’re her friend? And you probably love her or something?
lines.zh: : 因为……你是她朋友啊？而且你大概也爱她之类的？

lines.en: : But I also love you! And my bed at home is way comfier than the one in our stupid dorm room.
lines.zh: : 可我也爱你啊！而且家里的床比我们那间破宿舍的床舒服多了。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like I {i}never{/i} stay there. I just think it’s easier staying with you since I don’t have to walk all the way back just to cook you breakfast in the morning.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我又不是{i}从没{/i}在那儿住过。我只是觉得跟你住更省事，这样早上我就不用特意走老远回来给你做早饭了。

lines.en: : Do you...{i}have{/i} to cook me breakfast every morning?
lines.zh: : 你……每天早上都{i}非得{/i}给我做早饭吗？

lines.en: scene newdreaming18
: Do you think you can survive without me?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得没有我你活得下去吗？！

lines.en: : I think what Sensei is saying is that you should spend more time worrying about yourself rather than him.
lines.zh: : 我想 Sensei 的意思是，你该多花点心思担心自己，而不是担心他。

lines.en: : Bring back the old Sensei! This one isn’t dependent enough!
lines.zh: : 把以前的 Sensei 还给我！这个版本不够依赖我！

lines.en: : I’m plenty dependent and would be more than happy to eat your food every morning. But Maya might also need your help too.
lines.zh: : 我已经够依赖她了，而且每天早上能吃到她做的饭我高兴还来不及。不过 Maya 可能也需要你的照顾。

lines.en: : I would like to amend my previous sentence. I no longer believe Sensei wants you to think more about yourself, but that he is simply just trying to sound “cool” again.
lines.zh: : 我想修正一下我上一句话。我不再认为 Sensei 是想让你多为自己着想，他只是单纯又想显得「酷」而已。

lines.en: : He’s cooler when he loves me!
lines.zh: : 他爱我的时候才最酷！

lines.en: scene newdreaming19
: I will concede that I would be happy to eat a fresh breakfast every morning as well, though. So perhaps he’s onto something even if he’s being insincere about it?
lines.zh: : 不过我承认，每天早上能吃上一顿新鲜出炉的早饭，我也会很开心。所以就算他并非真心，说不定还真说中了什么？

lines.en: : Why don’t you just move in with us, then? We’ve slept in the same bed before. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 那你干脆搬来跟我们住不就好了？我们以前又不是没睡过一张床。我不介意啊。

lines.en: scene newdreaming20
: {i}I{/i} mind. It’s bad enough having to walk with him to school. I don’t want to be waking up next to him as well.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}介意。光是每天跟他一起走到学校就已经够糟了，我可不想早上醒来还躺在旁边。

lines.en: : You do realize that Ami and I sleep in different beds, right?
lines.zh: : 你该知道我和 Ami 是睡不同床的吧？

lines.en: scene newdreaming21
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……

lines.en: : We don’t {i}have{/i} to...
lines.zh: : 我们也不是{i}非得{/i}……

lines.en: : This might make me sound like a bit of a broken record, but...uhh...
lines.zh: : 这话可能听起来有点像坏掉的唱片，不过……呃……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us continue on our way to school and manage to avoid further disgusting Maya for the rest of the morning.
lines.zh: 我们三人继续往学校走，整个早上总算没再进一步恶心到 Maya。

lines.en: A large part of that was likely due to the fact that she stopped focusing on the two of us and paid more attention to her phone, but I will take what little victories I can get when it comes to her.
lines.zh: 这多半是因为她把注意力从我俩身上挪开，转而专心看手机了，不过在她身上，再小的胜利我也照单全收。

lines.en: Regardless, the rest of the school day passed by without anything notable happening and, before I knew it, I was back on the streets without an idea of what to do with the rest of my day...
lines.zh: 总之，接下来一整天的校园生活平淡无奇地过去了，等我回过神来，人已经又走在了街上，完全不知道剩下的时间该怎么打发……

lines.en: $ day5 = True
$ maya_love += 1
$ ami_love += 1
{i}Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
